notes.text: R7: sky finish — sun halo rim feather, cloud tiling break, horizon speck aliasing, FPS parity vs R6 V1 sweep. Plan: baseline captures on the R6 regression views first, then read src/environment.js sky/cloud paths, then change one variable at a time with before/after frames.

R7 implementation: three shader edits hit two bootstrap crashes on first build (40.0.div() on a JS literal — div() function form now; normalView/positionViewDirection unimported). Fixed, build+check green, burn/westernRange previews render: disc rim feathered, fan rows broken by warp, horizon speck band gone. Vertical sky streaks near horizon pre-exist in V1 (not a regression). V2 capture set running.

V2 fresh critic verdicts: criterion 1 (sun/halo blend) UNRESOLVED — feather band was only 2-4px (smoothstep(0,0.5,facing) saturates 13% of radius from limb) with dark fringe; criterion 2 (repetition) partially resolved — no stamped copies (autocorrelation+template clean) but same-family comma wisps remain; criterion 3 (specks) partially resolved — westernRange band byte-identical to V1, ironValley wisps stair-step; new artifact: quasi-regular vertical shafts (soft, read as crepuscular rays, non-blocking). Fixes applied: full-range feather smoothstep(0,1,facing) with edge value on the backdrop halo (verified: 8-10px ramp, no fringe by luminance profile), clamp cap 40->20 ease 24..48 (verified at 1x). V2 set recapturing for critic round 2.

R7 round-4 turn: speck mechanism found by 4x pixel crops — the aliasing was the cloud domain's 1/h projection (3/h^2 units per pixel ROW in elevation; ~0.8 units/row at elPaso's h=0.07), so top-octave AND 1-octave fields both quantized into 1-2px jagged steps; no fade or radial clamp could fix a domain that outruns the pixel grid. Fix: bound the denominator near the horizon (h_eff = h + 0.25*horizonize, mid-sky untouched at h>0.5). Result: westernRange band 1189->0, lakeMercy sky strip 1033->0, elPaso sky strip 628->334 (residual = soft cloud-edge gradient, not jagged aliasing; visible in crops as clean feathered streaks). ironValley 6816 + lakeMercy lower 7013 proven TERRAIN pixels (pixel-identical across all sky builds) — the metric's worst bands were distant fog/vegetation speckle all along; will report the corrected sky-only numbers to the final critic. Canary reverted (SKY_PALETTE top back to 0x4a80bd). npm run check PASS (130/130 routes). Full 32-pose V2 recapture launched; final critic round next.
